meta.name: Dakghor
meta.description: Damodar Das comes to the remote village of Hagda as its new postmaster. While their simple aspirations and pure emotions slowly do away with Damodar's reservations, he keeps searching for a sliver of his long-lost childhood.

videos.title: Bhuter Bari
videos.overview: Damodar Das lands in Hagda amidst colossal personal loss and an uncertain future. Awestruck to see their new postmaster, the villagers soon discover his connection with their haunted post office.

videos.title: Saap-er Hanchi
videos.overview: The arrival of Damodar makes the villagers throng the post office for their long-due correspondences. While Damodar faces difficulties to adjust in the new place, Madhusudan becomes his sole companion.

videos.title: Purano Akhor Guli
videos.overview: Damodar wins everyone's hearts with his solemn behaviour. But he is not at peace as memories haunt him and remind him of the sole motive behind taking up this job.

videos.title: Babar Jama
videos.overview: While Damodar learns a saddening truth about his parents from the villagers, he also gets suspicious about Madhusudan's whereabouts.

videos.title: Bhrantibilash
videos.overview: Madhusudan tries to marry off his daughter to Damodar. The latter confronts Madhusudan without knowing that a bigger shock is in store for him.

videos.title: Bohu Bashonay
videos.overview: Damodar's anger costs Madhusudan his job, and he becomes an enemy to the villagers. On the other hand, the despairing memories of his father lead Damodar to open his heart to Monjori.

videos.title: Apon Hote Bahir Hoye
videos.overview: A sudden arrival makes Damodar realise the significance of a letter to its recipient. But to deliver the letter that may change his life, Damodar needs to overcome his inner demons first.
